files.disposition: Composition of HUD/setup/error/strip and supplied children; no independent transport.

Effect connects singleton runtime factory. Missing desktop voice API yields null. OfflineAudioContext decodes Blob at 16kHz and averages channels locally; Float32Array passed to native transcribe. prepare passes modelId/language/hotwords. Optional history.save sends Uint8Array, mimeType, durationMs, keepDays; update swallows rejection. watchModels subscribes then lists; event wins race over initial list, list rejection ignored. Returned native unsubscribe is not consumed here.

Local getUserMedia with exact saved device; only OverconstrainedError/NotFoundError falls back to default. Permission/security and missing-device errors mapped explicitly. MediaRecorder MIME negotiation, 250ms chunks, Blob assembly; AudioContext analyser and 50ms meter. 120s limit depends on functioning meter; metering failure sets peak=1 and has no independent limit timer. Speech requires >=400ms, peak>=0.04 and nonempty blob. discard/late start stops tracks; release closes audio. No HTTP, WS, worker or resource URL.

Availability requires enabled, engineAvailable, media capability and !disabled; hidden suppresses registration. No permission request in support probe. Registers insert/submit/activate/isShown callbacks, reads latest refs, scope/listening cleanup unregisters and cancels owning session. Actual composer callback implementations are injected boundary, not enumerated app-wide.

Native downloadModel for absent/retry, cancelDownload for downloading, deleteModel only ready/manage. Choosing ready model and setup preferred ID updates local persisted settings. Setup close cancels, ready start toggles. License URL opens external resource via platform wrapper. Model rows null until snapshot; recommended locale selection is local.

Pointer press/release/cancel and keyboard click dispatch core session callbacks. Strip stop(false) inserts, stop(true) requests injected submit. Escape/shortcut handling in core. Error retry excludes unavailable. Canvas/ResizeObserver/RAF/matchMedia are local rendering; no resource URL, HTTP, WS or worker.

Three useQuery observers independently of voice enabled/engine state: agentListOptions, memberListOptions, projectListOptions. Nonarchived agent names, all member names and project titles form context words; workspace cleanup clears context. No mutation or transcription request.

native_boundary.implementation: Injected preload boundary only; no native implementation, channel names, download hosts, workers or production capability proven.

resources: model.licenseUrl -> openExternal: SSR no-op; desktopAPI.openExternal when present; otherwise window.open(_blank,noopener,noreferrer). same-tab branch exists in wrapper but is not requested by this caller. URL is dynamic resource, not an API route.
session_closure: connectVoiceRuntime is once-only even if factory returns null. Missing runtime no recording; missing ready model opens setup. prepare precedes recorder.start. Session tokens suppress late results after cancellation/unregister/scope change. Silence avoids transcribe; short <250ms cancels. Optional history saved only retention != off; status done/failed/interrupted, retry reuses failed clip when canRetry else begins new recording. Native failure model-missing opens setup, engine-unavailable gives unavailable, other failures retryable. Cleaned text inserted with up to 20 delayed retries; optional submit only after successful insert and explicit send. Injected submit may have downstream transport outside this bounded union; no invented send route.
local_operations: MediaRecorder, AudioContext, OfflineAudioContext, Blob/ArrayBuffer/typed arrays, canvas and timers are local browser APIs. No worker/postMessage transport exists in audited folder or inspected voice runtime adapter. Settings persist workpal_voice_input through defaultStorage localStorage; context hotwords dedupe/cap60 locally.
